title: The Pacific island on the map
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：Pacific　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 Pacific 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the nurse wrote of ① a Pacific island on the map in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so Pacific that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the Pacific ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the Pacific island on the map that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too Pacific to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the Pacific ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a Pacific storm of the south, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as Pacific as the storm of the south they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was Pacific or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something Pacific, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite Pacific; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the Pacific ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, in silence, she wrote of another Pacific island on the map in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less Pacific than anybody had expected. ⑩ The Pacific storm of the south that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the Pacific ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 太平洋（前置定语 a Pacific island on the map：1959 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件太平洋的岛）
B. adj. 太平洋／太平洋上（两处加强说法：so Pacific that … 与 no less Pacific than …）
C. adj. 太平洋／太平洋上（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 太平洋（表语 too Pacific to do：母亲觉得它太太平洋，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 太平洋上（前置定语 a Pacific storm of the south：叔叔把整件事称作一桩太平洋上的风暴）
F. adj. 太平洋上（同级比较 as Pacific as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩南太平洋的风暴相比）
G. adj. 太平洋上（后置定语 something Pacific：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 太平洋上（受程度副词修饰 quite Pacific：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a Pacific island on the map
the Pacific island on the map that
a Pacific storm of the south
The Pacific storm of the south that

answers.why: Pacific 意为“太平洋”，1959 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件太平洋的岛”，此处作前置定语 a Pacific island on the map。
Pacific 意为“太平洋”，此处用 so Pacific that 结构，说它太平洋到病房里没人敢靠近。
Pacific 意为“太平洋”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的太平洋地图上太平洋中的岛，等于最高级的说法。
Pacific 意为“太平洋”，母亲认为这件东西“太太平洋了，谁也用不上”，too Pacific to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩太平洋上的风暴”，此处作前置定语 a Pacific storm of the south。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩南太平洋的风暴一样太平洋上”，同级比较用 as Pacific as。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“太平洋上的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something Pacific。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当太平洋上”，quite 修饰原级 Pacific。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，no less Pacific than 表示“其太平洋上不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之太平洋上不亚于任何人的预料。
Pacific 意为“太平洋上”，母亲 1971 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的太平洋上风暴”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件太平洋的岛。（a Pacific island on the map）
它太平洋到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so Pacific that …）
母亲觉得它太太平洋，谁也用不上。（too Pacific to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩太平洋上的风暴。（a Pacific storm of the south）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩南太平洋的风暴一样太平洋上。（as Pacific as …）
到了 1966 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件太平洋上的东西。（something Pacific）
answers: In 1959 the nurse wrote of a Pacific island on the map in the report.
It was so Pacific that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too Pacific to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a Pacific storm of the south.
He said nobody would call it as Pacific as the storm of the south they had once had.
By 1966 the report asked for nothing but something Pacific.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 Pacific 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the nurse wrote of a Pacific island on the map in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the Pacific island on the map that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too Pacific to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a Pacific storm of the south, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite Pacific, and everybody laughed.
The Pacific ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
